g:HTMLPanel.p: Searchable single and multiple selects, drawn by one of three libraries: Tom Select 2, Choices.js 11 or Slim Select 4. Inherit org.gwtbootstrap5.extras.select.Select and the module of the library: org.gwtbootstrap5.extras.select.client.TomSelectResources, ChoicesResources or SlimSelectResources (or the …URL variant, which loads it from a CDN). Only the inherited libraries are compiled; with a single one, engine can be left out.

d:Example.heading: Single select
d:Example.description: `Select<T>` takes its options from Java with `setOptions`. Strings and enums work as they are; `placeholder` shows while nothing is selected and the search box filters as you type.

d:Example.heading: Multiple select, with objects
d:Example.description: `MultipleSelect<T>` keeps a list of values, up to `setMultipleLimit`. For objects, `setItemProvider` says which value and text each option has.

d:Example.heading: Remote search
d:Example.description: With `asyncLoad`, each search calls `asyncDataLoad`, which answers with the options found, for example from a server; `loadOnOpen` loads them on the first focus too.

d:Example.heading: Removed and added again
d:Example.description: A select removed from the page destroys its JavaScript select, and creates a new one when it is added again, keeping its options and value.
